sections.text:
هذه المواصفة مناسبة لتقدير الحموضة الكلية لزيوت العزل المعدنية المستعملة 
 والغير مستعملة وتطبق على زيوت المحولات والقواطع والزيوت الخالية من الاضافات 
 والتى بها اضافات.

قام بإعداد هذا المستند الكيميائية/ 
 سهير عبد الوارث حسن وتم مراجعة المستند 
 بمعرفة الكيميائي/ 
 خالد بسطاوى مكى محسب وقام بالاختبار السيد الكيميائي/ 
 اشرف صلاح الدين صالح وتم اعتماده من الكيميائى/ 
 محمد وجدى عبد الله 
 مدير عام بمحطة كهرباء السد العالى بشركة 
 المحطات المائية لإنتاج الكهرباء وموثق من المهندس/ 
 عبد النبى عبد الغنى عبد النبى 
 رئيس قطاع المحطة بشركة 
 المحطات المائية 
 لإنتاج الكهرباء.

وهذا المستند معتمد من المهندس/ 
 محمد اسامة سليمان سليم منسق الـMPIS بشركة 
 المحطات المائية لإنتاج الكهرباء.

معرفة مدى كفاءة الزيت اثناء التشغيل.

لتقدير الحموضة الكلية للعينة تذاب العينة فى مذيب 
 مناسب (خليط من الطولين والايثانول) وتعاير بمحلول قلوى 0.1 عيارى من
 KOH

الحموضة 
 الكلية: 
 هى قياس 
 مجموع كل من الحموضة العضوية والحموضة الغير عضوية
التأكد من ان زجاجة العينة جافة (خالية من المياه والاتربة).

يتم اخذ العينة بالطريقة السليمة السالف ذكرها طبقا للـ 
 (MPIS(Oil-013-r2
التأكد من وضع العينة بالصندوق الخاص بها لعدم تعرضها لضوء الشمس والاتربة.
التأكد من صحة البيانات الواردة مع العينة.

التأكد من ان عيارية وتركيز جميع المحاليل والمواد 
 الكيميائية المستخدمة فى التجربة مظبوطة تماما.

وضع المواد الكيميائية المستخدمة فى دواليب جيدة التهوية وفى اماكن بعيدة 
 عن اللهب.

عتد اجراء الاختبار نتجنب اسكاب 
 الزيت على الارض او الميزان وان حدث ذلك يتم ازالته.

ماصة مدرحة 1مل (كل تدريج 0.01 مل) - دورق قياسى - دورق مخروطى 250مل - 
 مخبار مدرج 100مل - ميزان حساس

هيدروكسيد البوتاسيوم كحولى 0.1عيارى - كحول اثيلى ايزوتروبيك - حمض
 HCL
 ش0.1 عيارى

طولين خالى من الكبريت - دليل الازرق القلوى 
 6B

خطوات تحضير دليل الازرق القلوى 
a6B

rows:
نزن 2 جم من دليل الازرق القلوى ثم نذيبها فى 100 مل كحول الايزوتربيك ثم 
 نضف 1 مل 
 0.1 
 عيارى HCL.

نترك الخليط السابق مدة 24 ساعة ثم نختبره بـ 
 KOH 
 الكحولى 0.1 عيارى حتى يتغير اللون من الازرق الى الاحمر الخمرى (القابل 
 للمقارنة مع محلول نترات الكوبالت %10).

بعد الاطمئنان على دقة حساسية الدليل نرشح الدليل ثم نحفظة فى زجاجة غامقة 
 اللون وتوضع فى مكان مظلم حتى لا يتعرض الدليل للضوء فيفقد حساسيته.

ملحوظة " اذا كانت حساسية الدليل 
 غير مرضية نضيف نقطة من 
 HCL
 ش 0.1 عيارى ونعيد اجراء الاختبار مرة اخرى 
 بعد 24 ساعة.
نزن 20 جرام من عينة الزيت فى دورق مخروطى سعة 250مل.

فى دورق مخرطى اخر اخلط 60 مل طولين + 40 مل كحول الايزوتروبى 
 .
اضف 2 مل من دليل الازرق - القلوى على الخليط فيصبح لون الخليط ازرق.

عادل الخليط باستخدام محلول 
 KOH
 ش 0.1
 عيارى 
 حتى يتغبر اللون من الازرق الى الاحمر الخمرى (القابل للمقارنة مع محلول 
 نترات الكوبالت %10) والذى يبقى لمدة 15 ثانية.

اضيف 
 هذا الخليط الى العينة مع التقليب جيدا ونعاير فى الحال باستخدام محلول 
 KOH
 ش 0.1 
 عيارى.

يتم حساب قيمة التعادل (NV) 
 من المعادلة الاتية:

V =
 حجم هيدروكسيد البوتاسيوم الكحولى المستهلك فى عملية 
 المعايرة
 N = 
 عيارية هيدروكسيد البوتاسيوم الكحولى 0.1 عيارى
 P 
 = 
 وزن عينة الزيت المراد اختباره بالجرام

sections_en.text: This specification is suitable for determining the total acidity of used and unused mineral insulating oils, and applies to transformer and circuit-breaker oils, with and without additives.

This document was prepared by the chemist Soheir Abdel Wareth Hassan, reviewed by the chemist Khaled Bastawy Makki Mohasseb, tested by the chemist Ashraf Salah El-Din Saleh, and approved by the chemist Mohamed Wagdy Abdallah, General Manager of High Dam Power Station, Hydro Power Plants Company for Electricity Production, and certified by Eng. Abdel Nabi Abdel Ghany Abdel Nabi, Head of the Station Sector, Hydro Power Plants Company for Electricity Production.
This document is approved by Eng. Mohamed Osama Soliman Selim, MPIS Coordinator, Hydro Power Plants Company for Electricity Production.

rows: Determination of the total acidity of new oil to check its conformity with the specifications.
Determination of the total acidity of used oil to determine the extent of oil oxidation during operation.
Determining the efficiency of the oil during operation.
To determine the total acidity of the sample, the sample is dissolved in a suitable solvent (a mixture of toluene and ethanol) and titrated with a 0.1 N alkaline solution of KOH.
Total acidity: a measure of the sum of both organic acidity and inorganic acidity.
Make sure the sample bottle is dry (free of water and dust).
The sample is taken in the correct manner mentioned above, in accordance with MPIS (Oil-013-r2)
Make sure the sample is placed in its own box so that it is not exposed to sunlight and dust.
Make sure the data supplied with the sample are correct.
Make sure that the normality and concentration of all solutions and chemicals used in the test are exactly correct.
Place the chemicals used in well-ventilated cabinets, in places away from flames.
When carrying out the test, avoid spilling oil on the floor or on the balance; if this happens, remove it.
Graduated pipette 1 ml (each division 0.01 ml) - volumetric flask - 250 ml conical flask - 100 ml graduated cylinder - sensitive balance
0.1 N alcoholic potassium hydroxide - isopropyl alcohol - 0.1 N HCl
Sulphur-free toluene - alkaline blue indicator 6B

sections_en.text: Steps for preparing the alkaline blue indicator 6B

rows: Weigh 2 g of the alkaline blue indicator, dissolve it in 100 ml of isopropyl alcohol, then add 1 ml of 0.1 N HCl.
Leave the above mixture for 24 hours, then test it with 0.1 N alcoholic KOH until the colour changes from blue to wine red (comparable with a 10% cobalt nitrate solution).

After confirming the accuracy of the indicator sensitivity, filter the indicator and keep it in a dark-coloured bottle placed in a dark place, so that the indicator is not exposed to light and does not lose its sensitivity.
Note: if the indicator sensitivity is unsatisfactory, add a drop of 0.1 N HCl and repeat the test again after 24 hours.
Weigh 20 g of the oil sample in a 250 ml conical flask.
In another conical flask, mix 60 ml of toluene + 40 ml of isopropyl alcohol.
Add 2 ml of the alkaline blue indicator to the mixture; the mixture turns blue.
Neutralize the mixture using 0.1 N KOH solution until the colour changes from blue to wine red (comparable with a 10% cobalt nitrate solution), which remains for 15 seconds.
Add this mixture to the sample with good stirring, and titrate immediately using 0.1 N KOH solution.
The neutralization value (NV) is calculated from the following equation:
V = volume of alcoholic potassium hydroxide consumed in the titration; N = normality of alcoholic potassium hydroxide, 0.1 N; P = weight of the oil sample to be tested, in grams

Document No.: Oil-016-r0a | Equipment: Standard test method for acidity of petroleum producte (Neutralization value)a
Issued to: High Dam Power Station
Document Status: Approved
Document Approval Date: 19 January 2009 | Procedure: According to IEC 296/82
Date of Next Review: January 2014
Introduction
This specification is suitable for determining the total acidity of used and unused mineral insulating oils, and applies to transformer and circuit-breaker oils, with and without additives.
This document was prepared by the chemist Soheir Abdel Wareth Hassan, reviewed by the chemist Khaled Bastawy Makki Mohasseb, tested by the chemist Ashraf Salah El-Din Saleh, and approved by the chemist Mohamed Wagdy Abdallah, General Manager of High Dam Power Station, Hydro Power Plants Company for Electricity Production, and certified by Eng. Abdel Nabi Abdel Ghany Abdel Nabi, Head of the Station Sector, Hydro Power Plants Company for Electricity Production.
This document is approved by Eng. Mohamed Osama Soliman Selim, MPIS Coordinator, Hydro Power Plants Company for Electricity Production.
Objective
Determination of the total acidity of new oil to check its conformity with the specifications. | 
Determination of the total acidity of used oil to determine the extent of oil oxidation during operation. | 
Determining the efficiency of the oil during operation. | 
Summary of Method
To determine the total acidity of the sample, the sample is dissolved in a suitable solvent (a mixture of toluene and ethanol) and titrated with a 0.1 N alkaline solution of KOH. | 
Definition
Total acidity: a measure of the sum of both organic acidity and inorganic acidity.
Procedures Required for Measurement Accuracy
Make sure the sample bottle is dry (free of water and dust). | 1.
The sample is taken in the correct manner mentioned above, in accordance with MPIS (Oil-013-r2) | 2.
Make sure the sample is placed in its own box so that it is not exposed to sunlight and dust. | 3.
Make sure the data supplied with the sample are correct. | 4.
Make sure that the normality and concentration of all solutions and chemicals used in the test are exactly correct. | 5.
Environmental Recommendations
Place the chemicals used in well-ventilated cabinets, in places away from flames. | 1.
When carrying out the test, avoid spilling oil on the floor or on the balance; if this happens, remove it. | 2.
Tools and Materials Used
Graduated pipette 1 ml (each division 0.01 ml) - volumetric flask - 250 ml conical flask - 100 ml graduated cylinder - sensitive balance | 1.
0.1 N alcoholic potassium hydroxide - isopropyl alcohol - 0.1 N HCl | 2.
Sulphur-free toluene - alkaline blue indicator 6B | 3.
Procedures to be Carried Out
Steps for preparing the alkaline blue indicator 6B
Weigh 2 g of the alkaline blue indicator, dissolve it in 100 ml of isopropyl alcohol, then add 1 ml of 0.1 N HCl. | 1.
Leave the above mixture for 24 hours, then test it with 0.1 N alcoholic KOH until the colour changes from blue to wine red (comparable with a 10% cobalt nitrate solution). | 2.
After confirming the accuracy of the indicator sensitivity, filter the indicator and keep it in a dark-coloured bottle placed in a dark place, so that the indicator is not exposed to light and does not lose its sensitivity. | 3.
Note: if the indicator sensitivity is unsatisfactory, add a drop of 0.1 N HCl and repeat the test again after 24 hours.
Test Steps
Weigh 20 g of the oil sample in a 250 ml conical flask. | 1.
In another conical flask, mix 60 ml of toluene + 40 ml of isopropyl alcohol. | 2.
Add 2 ml of the alkaline blue indicator to the mixture; the mixture turns blue. | 3.
Neutralize the mixture using 0.1 N KOH solution until the colour changes from blue to wine red (comparable with a 10% cobalt nitrate solution), which remains for 15 seconds. | 4.
Add this mixture to the sample with good stirring, and titrate immediately using 0.1 N KOH solution. | 5.
Calculations
The neutralization value (NV) is calculated from the following equation:
N xV x 56.1
